title: Interstellar
definition: Interstellar refers to the physical space, matter, and radiation existing between star systems within a galaxy, comprised of the Interstellar Medium (ISM) made of gas and cosmic dust.
importanceInUpsc: Tested under Science and Technology (Space Physics, Cosmic Phenomena, Astronomy) in Prelims through conceptual questions on cosmic rays, nebulae, and stellar lifecycle, and in Mains regarding India's advancements in astronomy and astrophysics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Interstellar space and the Interstellar Medium (ISM).
Evaluate spatial distribution, classification of ISM phases, and institutional frameworks of space exploration.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions on cosmic physics.
